Sorry to hear it. Two quick things and I can get it moving.

What's it doing, and has it ever been run above its rated hashrate? Overclocked or modified units aren't covered, so I need to ask up front.

If it's a genuine fault, the route is our RMA form, which gets you a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Processing takes up to 10 days once the unit lands at the warehouse. If it's a dead PSU only, we can send a PSU instead, no return needed.
Updated firmware, reapplied screen, and will not begin Hashing. Log shows that ASIC rails are off either no option to turn on via UI.
Handed to the team · Rail-level fault I can't diagnose from product data.

That reads like a hardware fault, not a config one. If the rails never come up there's usually no UI switch for it.

One thing worth trying first: full power down, PSU cable out for a minute, check the board power connector is fully seated, then boot with the screen unplugged.

If it still won't hash, file the RMA so a label goes out: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

I've put this in front of JD, who does our hardware. Fastest answer is Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate. He'll also reply here or by email.
